description:
Get Gene Ontology term definition.
Data: Open Targets Platform 25.09 · table go — one record = one Gene Ontology term.
Key: id.
Arguments: go_id accepts go term (resolved; unknown -> error).
Results: `_vbt.total` counts all matches.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. GO terms of OT 25.09, including obsolete terms named 'obsolete ...'.

go_id.description: Accepts go_term; resolved to one go_term (unknown values are errors, never empty results).
